_README: THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR D5(b). One member, one model, one key.
N - 1 DISTINCT MODELS, WHICH IS THE SHAPE THE BRIEF ASKS FOR. Six members,
FIVE distinct models. The sixth runs the D2(b) v1 pass on a model already
in the battery: 'to compare two prompt versions you hold the model fixed;
to compare models you hold the prompt fixed.'
cheap  A  rohit_panda   meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct    v2
mid    B  huang_yu      openai/gpt-4o-mini                  v2
mid    C  xia_yanran    qwen/qwen-2.5-72b-instruct          v2
cheap  D  li_yunke      google/gemma-3-12b-it               v2
mid    E  shen_bowen    anthropic/claude-3-haiku            v2
cheap  A  zhao_yujia    meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct    v1  <- mirrors A
TWO CHEAP, THREE MID, FIVE DIFFERENT FAMILIES - meta-llama, openai, qwen,
google, anthropic. Both of the brief's conditions hold: the v2 set spans
two price tiers, and no two v2 members share a family. Checked in code by
validate_roster(), not left to memory.
PAID, DELIBERATELY. A previous revision put five members on US$0 models.
It cost nothing and broke D6: at one price tier layer 1 is zero for every
model, the four-lever ledger has nothing to weigh, and break-even
1-(E-C)/F degenerates to 100%. The whole battery costs US$1.24 - about
2% of the team's six US$10 keys - and it buys a cost comparison that can
actually be reported.
FILLED AND VERIFIED 2026-09-09 against the LIVE OpenRouter /models
endpoint. Every id was confirmed to exist and to advertise tool calling.
Model ids are not guessable: slugs inferred from the web listing have been
wrong three times on this project, and each would have raised
LiveFatalError on the first call of a paid run.
TIER IS ASSIGNED BY MEASURED BATTERY COST, not by vendor reputation:
cheap  <= US$0.20 for 60 trials
frontier > US$1.00   (refused: see GUARDRAILS.md 4.1)
Costed on our OWN measured tokens - 18,190 in / 542 out per trial from
results/scripted/ - with a x3 safety factor on output, because a scripted
transcript is a FLOOR on what a live model writes.
60 TRIALS, NOT 56. The brief's example set is 40 cases / 8 negative / 56
trials. Ours is 40 / 10 / 60, because nine of the fifteen SHIPPED cases
are already negative and a shipped row may not be deleted. The number is
DERIVED by battery_provenance.plan_shape() and cross-checked against
trials_expected below; if they disagree the roster is wrong, never the
derivation.
THE JUDGE IS NOT ON THIS ROSTER, and must never be. D4: 'use a different
model from the one being graded.' evals/graders/judge.py defaults to
mistralai/mistral-small-2603 - Mistral is deliberately absent below.
RE-VERIFY BEFORE THE BATTERY:  python3 evals/check_roster_prices.py
battery_tag is resolved to a commit SHA at runtime. Cut the tag, then
nobody runs until `git rev-list -n1 <tag>` equals their HEAD.
trial_policy: 30 ordinary x1 + 10 negative x3 = 60 (derived; see battery_provenance.plan_shape)

expected._note: Filled by `python3 run_battery.py --freeze` once, at the frozen commit. Every later run compares against these and refuses on a mismatch, naming the component that moved.

members._note: MODEL A, cheap tier. zhao_yujia's v1 pass runs on this same model.
MODEL C, mid tier. The most expensive row, and still 14% of the ceiling.
MODEL E, mid tier. Output costs 5x input here - the asymmetry D6 lever 3 is about.

THE v1 PASS - the sixth member, and the reason this is N-1 models rather than N. Same model as rohit_panda's, so the only variable is our own writing. Its family duplicating MODEL A is correct and intended: the family rule applies to the five v2 models.
